artworks.title: A Village on a Hill
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line. The area is gently rolling with vegetation, a windmill on the horizon, a large detailed tree on the right, and a building with steep roofs and chimneys partially hidden by the tree. The style is precise etching with attention to texture and contour. The color palette is black and white with strong contrast for depth and detail.

artworks.title: Watermill at the Foot of a Hill
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with various elements. The view is slightly from above, allowing a detailed scene. The horizon is low, with the sky in the upper half. There is a building with a water wheel on the left, surrounded by trees. Rolling hills and trees are in the middle distance, creating a boundary as the land slopes to the right. In the background, distant hills rise on the left, with a hint of a hilltop. The brushstrokes are fine, detailing textures in foliage and structures. The color palette is sepia, giving a historical feel to the scene.

artworks.title: A Wooden and a Stone Bridge
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 15.2 x 20.3 cm (6 x 8 in.)
sheet: 15.2 x 20.6 cm (6 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a stone bridge crossing a stream. Rocks and water are visible near the stream's edge. A pair of trees with detailed branches is on the right, while buildings, including a church, are seen further back. Hills mark the horizon, and the sky is filled with clouds. The artwork predominantly uses a monochrome color palette.

artworks.title: The Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I after Maarten de Vos
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious coronation scene with three figures. Two figures are placing a crown on the head of a third figure. A dove is above them. The scene is surrounded by clouds and a landscape with a building below. The border includes allegoric figures and Latin text. The composition is detailed and features iconographic and textual elements.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child in a Landscape
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Albrecht Dürer
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 32.2 x 23.6 cm (12 11/16 x 9 5/16 in.) (cut within platemark; part of inscription trimmed off)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated with a child on her lap. The woman is leaning forward, looking down with eyes partially closed. She has long, straight hair, partially covered by a veil, and is wearing a draped gown with long sleeves. The unclothed child is reaching outward and held securely by the woman. The scene includes animals, plants, and a pastoral setting with a wooden building, shepherds, and hills in the background. A star shines above among clouds.

artworks.title: Rocky Landscape in Bohemia
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed landscape with a cityscape in the distance. Buildings with domed and spired roofs rise against the sky. A castle-like structure sits amidst greenery on rocky terrain. The style features intricate linear detail, creating a textured appearance. The color palette is monochromatic gray. Trees and people are visible in the foreground, adding scale and activity. In the distance, buildings extend to hills or mountains under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: View of a Hilltown
artworks.artist: Jeanne Deny, after Jan van der Heyden
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is low, with a vast sky dominating the scene. The sky has various cloud formations rendered with delicate brushstrokes. A detailed tree is on the right, with a cluster of buildings and a church tower on a hill in the distance. Fields stretch to the horizon on the left. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray for contrast and shading.

artworks.title: Apollo and the Muses
artworks.artist: Jules Boilly after Pierre Paul Prud'hon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts two adult female figures and a small child-like figure with wings. The adult figures are dressed in flowing garments, arranged in a manner that suggests movement, while the child figure stands between them. The wings on the child figure indicate a mythological representation. The color of the sculpture is a muted, monochromatic shade resembling a light stone or plaster. The sculpture is engraved with the names "TERPSICHORE" and "ERATO" at the base. The figures could represent Greek Muses. The sculpture is intricately detailed with an emphasis on the soft texture and graceful outlines of the figures.

artworks.title: Longitudinal View of Saint Peter's, Rome
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 28.6 x 44.8 cm (11 1/4 x 17 5/8 in.) (cut within image; irregular)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure. It shows a detailed architectural elevation of a large, classical-style building with a prominent dome, flanked by two smaller domes. The building is richly adorned with columns, pediments, and detailed ornamentation. The central dome is intricately decorated and is a dominant feature. Around the main dome, smaller architectural details and sculptures are drawn with precision. The drawing emphasizes the symmetrical and harmonious design typical of significant architectural works.

artworks.title: Balaam and the Angel
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: etching and engraving [left plate of 2 plates] on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with ancient ruins. The artwork shows a bearded warrior riding a horse, making a gesture with one hand holding the horse's reins. The setting includes decaying stone structures covered in ivy, featuring arches, columns, and statues. The intricate details of foliage and masonry create a rich texture. The composition conveys a sense of a mythological narrative or allegory.

artworks.title: Standing Young Peasant Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing facing slightly to the right while also facing forward. Her facial features are refined and delicate, with her gaze directed upwards. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with curls. She is wearing a long, flowing gown with loose-fitting long sleeves. The dress appears to be gathered around her arm as she holds it with one hand while the other hand lightly touches the folded fabric. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects in her hands. The background is plain, without any discernible features, providing a simple, clean backdrop to the figure.

artworks.title: Man with a Sword
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright facing slightly left. The individual wears a broad-brimmed hat, medium-length curly hair, a long coat with lace cuffs, a waistcoat, and a cravat at the neck. They hold a cane in their right hand, and their left hand is on their hip. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Standing Servant Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman standing. She has her left hand on her hip and her right hand resting across her stomach. Her head is turned slightly to the right. She has long hair worn beneath a head covering. Her facial features are distinct, with a calm expression. She is wearing a long, loose dress with rolled-up sleeves, a buttoned front, and detailed texture indicating stripes on the skirt and a pattern on the bodice. She appears to be barefoot. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Standing Man Viewed from Behind
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a person viewed from behind in a relaxed posture. The person has curly hair, wears a wide-brimmed hat, and an oversized coat with loose-fitting sleeves that extend to their ankles. Their feet are partially visible. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The March of Silenus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with multiple figures and elements. The artwork shows a group of figures reclining and lounging in a natural setting, possibly under the shade of a tree with expansive roots. The figures appear intertwined, with some reclining against each other. There are also figures engaged in other activities, such as children climbing or reaching out. In the background, there is an altar or platform with figures gathered around. The style is reminiscent of the works of Jean-Honoré Fragonard, with intricate detail and fluid lines capturing motion and emotion.

artworks.title: Décroteur et Ramoneur (Scraper and Chimney Sweep)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper [proof before letters]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. The image shows several individuals engaged in varying activities on a street next to a small building with an arched doorway and windows. There are at least three figures prominently visible, one standing with a cane, another bending over a container, and a dog nearby. Further in the background, more figures are seen walking or standing, and part of a building is visible on the left. Fine lines and attention to detail capture the textures and clothing styles, suggesting a moment of everyday life.

artworks.title: Ruins of an Old Castle at Saint-Chamond, Loire
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows an old stone structure, potentially a castle or fortification, slightly to the right of the center. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, revealing the structure and surrounding landscape which slopes downwards. The artwork is a detailed drawing in sepia ink, presenting the ancient architecture with signs of wear and age, such as a partially ruined cylindrical tower with plants and small trees growing on it. A figure holding a staff is shown on a path leading to the building, offering a sense of scale. In the distance, more parts of the structure and some foliage are visible. The color palette is limited to various shades of brown, creating a historical and timeless visual.

artworks.title: Two Houses with Tile Roofs
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic stone building centrally positioned, with trees on the left and right. The perspective is straightforward and slightly elevated. The brushstrokes are fine, creating detailed textures in the architecture and foliage. The color palette is primarily sepia. A solitary figure is sitting with a staff or rod on the lower right. Two structures in the distance connect with trees, creating a rural setting. The scene captures a tranquil moment in the countryside.

artworks.title: The Spinner
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This image depicts an outdoor scene with a rustic setting. In the foreground, two figures are shown near a wooden structure and a stone wall. The background shows a landscape with small hills and scattered vegetation. The sky above features simple cloud and bird motifs. The illustration style is detailed and textured, using sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Spring at l'Orsière
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an arched stone structure that appears to be part of an old ruin. The horizon line is high, with earthy terrain and foliage beyond. The fine cross-hatching and line work detail texture of the stonework and vegetation. The color palette is sepia, creating a monochromatic look. In the foreground, there is a stone trough or similar structure, adding depth to the composition. Sparse shrubs and greenery are present in the scene, diversifying the brown and beige tones.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Arch
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. In the center left, there is an ancient stone archway standing amidst some ruins, with a round relief on its side and overgrown with vegetation. The horizon is low and mostly obscured by the lush trees and the structure itself, with hints of distant landscape visible through the arch. The artwork is made with fine, intricate linework, creating detailed textures for the foliage and the stone. The color palette consists predominantly of sepia tones. Closest to us, two figures in period clothing engage in conversation. To the right, a large stone tablet is visible with engraved text, partially covered by foliage and smaller rocks. The scene is framed by trees with branches and leaves detailed with delicate, cross-hatched strokes.

artworks.title: Ancient Tower at a Water Mill
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural structures and natural elements. In the center, there is a tall cylindrical structure surrounded by trees, with more trees in the background. The image is created using intricate lines to depict stone textures, foliage, and the sky. The color palette is primarily sepia tones. On the left, there is a figure with a walking stick and a goat, casting long shadows. On the right, there is a wheel near the building, possibly part of a watermill.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting with a notebook on his lap by a window. He wears a turban, loose robes, and sandals. The man has a beard and is focused on writing or drawing. There is a figure resembling an angel with large wings standing slightly behind him. The background is textured, highlighting a serene atmosphere with light coming in from the window.

artworks.title: A Scene from the New Testament
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows various individuals inside a domestic setting. The majority of the bodies are depicted from head to toe, showcasing people in different positions and activities. To the right, a man dressed in flowing robes stands at the doorway, with his arm raised, while another person looks on from behind him. Next to him, inside the room, another person stands next to the opened door, motioning towards the group inside. At the center of the image, a table is surrounded by a group, including children seated and standing. They wear loose-fitting garments typical of historical attire. One man near the table is bearded and gesturing with a hand across his chest. On the left, a woman holds a child on a staircase, partially illuminated by light. Another figure ascends the stairs carrying an object. The background features shadowed walls and arched architecture.
